newsitem.title: USA: Sparta Foods FY96 first profit since FY92.
newsitem.headline: Sparta Foods FY96 first profit since FY92.

text.p: Sparta Foods Inc said Thursday that fiscal 1996, ended September 30, was its first profitable year since 1992.

Earlier, it reported earnings for the year of $0.02 a share on a primary basis, compared with a loss in fiscal 1995 of $0.24 a share. For the fourth quarter, it earned $0.01 a share compared with a year-ago loss of $0.10.

"We have restored Sparta Foods to profitability, which has been our primary objective over the past two years," Joel Bachul, president, said in a statement. "During fiscal 1996, we completed a financial restructuring, implemented improvements in manufacturing operations, refined our product mix and aggressively managed expenses."
Sparta makes and markets Mexican-style food products, including tortillas.

"Looking forward to 1997 and beyond, we intend to capitalize on our existing brand name strength to increase Sparta Foods' share of the retail market while we increase our rate of growth and further improve operating margins," Bachul said.
